headline: This Catalyst Makes Eli Lilly a Top Growth Stock in 2026

headline: Par Health Launches First and Only Generic Version of Janumet® XR (sitagliptin and metformin HCl extended-release) Tablets in the United States
summary: Par Health, Inc. ("Par Health" or the "Company"), a global pharmaceutical company and manufacturer of essential medicines, today announced the launch of its generic version of Merck's Janumet® XR (sitagliptin and metformin HCl extended-release) tablets for oral use, following final approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) of its Abbreviated New Drug Application.

headline: Merck Announces Initial Access Plans for Alimatravir, an Investigational Once-Monthly Oral HIV Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis in Phase 3 Development
summary: RAHWAY, N.J., July 24, 2026--Voluntary licensing agreements cover 129 countries in regions which account for the substantial majority of new HIV diagnoses globally.
